name: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme
benefit:
- Eligible scholars under the Junior category shall be awarded a fellowship of ₹25,000/- per month for a period of 24 months.
- Eligible scholars under the Senior category shall be awarded a fellowship of ₹40,000/- per month for a period of 24 months.
- Maximum two fellowships shall be awarded under the Junior category.
- Maximum two fellowships shall be awarded under the Senior category.

##### *
_eligibility_text: ##### ***For Junior Research Fellowship*** - The applicant must have completed her/his post-graduation (M.A. in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology/History/Indology). - The applicant must be up to 35 years of age as on the closing date of application. - The applicant, if applying as a Goan Scholar, must have 15 years of Residence in Goa. - The applicant, if applying as an Indian Scholar, must have Indian citizenship. ##### ***For Senior Research Fellowship*** - The applicant must have completed her/his Doctorate (in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology/History/Indology). - The applicant must be up to 45 years of age as on the closing date of application. - The applicant, if applying as a Goan Scholar, must have 15 years of Residence in Goa. - The applicant, if applying as an Indian Scholar, must have Indian citizenship.
